en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an ornate, late‑19th/early‑20th‑century building labeled as the Romanian National House, seen from the street with bare tree branches in the foreground. Printed German caption reads "Gruß aus Hermannstadt" and "Rumänisches Nationalhaus." Publisher credit appears at the bottom. The reverse side uses the Hungarian postcard header "Levelező‑Lap." and bears a purple ownership stamp.
